verdict_text:
YES

The script loads the sharded checkpoint via the index, builds the keep index for one 2048-wide segment of 16 blocks of 128 skipping head 5, which yields exactly rows/columns 0..639 and 768..2047 in order. It applies that on axis 0 for q, k, v and axis 1 for o in all 16 layers, leaves every other tensor untouched under the same names, asserts the five required checks before writing, and saves a single file to `out/T2/model.safetensors` with 114 tensors.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
